category: Usenet NZB index (vBulletin forum, no API)

free_tier.stated: Reported allowance on a free account: 2 NZBs per day; no API because it is a forum. The NZB section lists current releases and has a Register link.
free_tier.notes: The allowance is third-party; a second listing describes the site as forum-based NZB link sharing rather than NZB files, so what a download returns was not confirmed.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file or a link, never the payload

retention.stated: not stated on the pages read. A third-party listing claims 'Approximately 500 days'.

egress.terms: No byte metering; the answer is an NZB pointer file or a link.

interface_detail: A vBulletin forum with a releases section; NZBs are fetched through the web UI after login. Third-party listings state it has no API.
tooling: A wrapper has to log in and drive the forum pages; Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 cannot add a forum as a Newznab indexer. That is a tooling note, not a verdict.
chaining: A manual fallback for a name that the API indexers lack; 2 NZBs a day makes it a last-resort grab, not a bulk path.

limits.value: reported: 2 NZBs per day on a free account, no API

binding_note: The two NZBs a day is the only numeric limit named, and it is third-party.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the register form was not read; the section shows a Register link and third-party listings call registration open. A forum sign-up normally takes an email address.

reliability_note: A third-party listing reports 99% uptime and a 1,776ms response time; the section loaded today.
confidence_note: The live release list and the Register link are first-party; the allowance, the price and the open registration are third-party.

evidence.proved: the NZB section lists a 2026 release on the read date, so it is live
